entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.comment:
Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category XXIV - agricultural services, excluding services related to animals not listed in Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category I (75.00.11) and construction and maintenance of gardens (81.30.11)

The reduced rate only applies for services in 01.61, 01.62, 01.64, 75.00.12 in that context

The goods supplied with the agricultural services are subject to the VAT rate applicable to the goods as if delivered separately, e.g.

entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.comment:
Some products are taxed at 13%. 
The tax rate on animals applies only to live stock, agricultural labor and reproductive.
